verdict.rationale: Supabase offers a Management API to manage projects/organizations programmatically (docs-28), a CLI to spin up local projects (docs-5/32), and branching that creates isolated preview-environment databases per PR (docs-26/36) — all of which support programmatic creation of isolated database environments. However, each Supabase project/branch is a full hosted Postgres instance, and there is no evidence of cost efficiency or architecture suited to spinning up thousands of lightweight per-agent/per-tenant databases; the branching feature is documented for PR-based previews, not massive fleets, and community threads (e.g. supabase-comm-5/6) flag friction with migrations/dashboard workflows at scale rather than confirming thousands-scale support. Missing for 10: evidence of per-database cost/pricing at scale, documented support for spinning up thousands of isolated DBs, and any case study of fleet-scale programmatic provisioning.
